'''Longshot''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served under [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Longshot was part of the team to rescue [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], who was being held captive in a [[Citadel/Legends|prison]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]]. He was killed in the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] when an electrified wall closed in on the rescue team, electrocuting him.<ref name="The Citadel" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] Longshot stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|Imperial standard meter]].<ref name="Db:CT" />

==Equipment==
Longshot utilized white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] and a standard [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]].<ref name="The Citadel" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the episode, Longshot was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all clone troopers through the series.<ref name="The Citadel" />
